text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Coe Hill Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a designated on-street accessible loading zone, fronting No. 80 Coe Hill Drive, located on the west side of Coe Hill Drive, between Windermere Avenue and The Queensway. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access for Wheel-Trans and accessible permit holders. This proposal will not result in the loss of any parking spaces.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate an accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the west side of Coe Hill Drive, between a point 247 metres south of Windermere Avenue and a point 11 metres further south.
